description: Road Density at the Township level Prod2 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by The Asia Foundation. This is the Road Density Township section from Open Street Map (OSM) for the length of roads and GIS technology for the surface of the township. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher The Asia Foundation. Its tags are Aid and development, Roads and bridges, Transport and shipping. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, pdf, txt, xlsx. The portal shows 2019-05-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
